blocks.content:
Not intentional — I found the cause and delegated a fix.

The PR chip in the wake-card header is rendered as a shared `Button` component whose base style includes `justify-center`:
base: 'type-body relative inline-flex shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center ...',

The chip has `flex-1 text-left`, but since the button itself is a flex container, `justify-center` centers the label inside the stretched button — `text-left` doesn't help. The hook-wake variant uses a plain `<span>`, which is why only PR wakes look centered.

I added a third task to the spec (add `justify-start` on the chip, leaving the shared Button variants untouched) and delegated it. Meanwhile the verifier for the first two tasks is still running. I'll report back when both settle.
